captures.notes: The mass is compact and visibly staggered, but the pale upper public surface still joins into a broad central patch and the upper orange compact gables repeat too often.
The reverse overview confirms real roof and footprint variety, while also exposing the wide upper deck and two unbounded market approaches at the perimeter.
This section is the strongest result: terrain-grounded and elevated bases step across the silhouette, blue and orange complete roofs vary, and roofed shallow bays interrupt the taller facades.
The stocked market is valid, but the public approach remains a straight exposed ramp before it reaches the first enclosing turn.
Several offset facades and roofed projections make a convincing street wall, yet the outside ground remains visible along the approach side rather than closing quickly around the player.
The hostile cross view reads as a true undercroft: multiple exterior ramps cross at different heights, buildings bound the path, and no long ground chord exits the opposite side.
The upper route is connected and passes addressed facades, but adjacent lanes merge into a court wider than the intended narrow negative-space path.
The occupied bridge and roof-level path are connected, though their neighboring landings merge into the same broad upper surface instead of a short bridge between distinct alleys.
The underside shows genuine inhabited and public overhangs with structural supports; route surfaces meet their seams and the lower passage remains exterior.
The roofline includes blue long roofs and multiple pitches, but repeated orange compact gables still dominate the middle-distance silhouette.
The overhead falsification view most clearly exposes the central contiguous deck and the repeated compact-roof cluster, despite the valid guarded lightwells and complete outer roofs.

findings.evidence: overview-ne, overview-sw, upper-route, skywalk-side, and network-above show adjacent public lanes coalescing into one broad pale upper deck.
findings.invariant: Inside the core, public circulation must remain a winding player-width negative-space network; a wide court is permitted only as a small explicit episode divided by buildings, occupied links, or guarded lightwells.

findings.evidence: entry and ground-reverse retain a straight exposed approach with the outside terrain visible beside the first route segment.
findings.invariant: After the perimeter landing, the market approach should turn into a facade-bounded alley promptly; sparse exterior stalls may not substitute for the city wall.

findings.evidence: overview-ne, overview-sw, roofline, and network-above show several adjacent orange compact gables with closely repeated silhouettes.
findings.invariant: A local roof cluster must mix footprint, pitch, material, feature, and base-height families; graph-colour labels count only when the selected baked mesh is visibly different.
